unit:src/features/build-tools/model.test.proof: `build_tools::model::tests::shows_profiles_then_the_aggregator_with_lifecycle_plugins_and_its_modules`, `build_tools::model::tests::expands_plugins_to_goals_and_dependencies_to_their_transitive_ones`, `build_tools::model::tests::lists_the_projects_maven_run_configurations`, `build_tools::model::tests::expand_all_opens_folders_but_not_dependency_subtrees`, `build_tools::model::tests::keeps_explicit_maven_profiles`, `build_tools::model::tests::passes_goals_offline_skip_tests_and_changed_profiles`, `build_tools::model::tests::parses_typed_command_lines`, `build_tools::model::tests::completes_phases_and_plugin_goals_for_the_last_word_history_for_the_whole_line`, `build_tools::model::tests::nests_subprojects_and_groups_tasks_other_last`, `build_tools::model::tests::runs_tasks_by_path_from_the_build_directory`, `build_tools::model::tests::keeps_identical_project_paths_and_tasks_of_independent_builds_distinct`, `build_tools::model::tests::shows_run_configurations_only_under_their_owning_linked_build`, `build_tools::model::tests::places_a_saved_run_under_its_directly_linked_root_instead_of_a_longer_sibling_composite`, `build_tools::model::tests::completes_task_names_and_paths`; 14 of 15 cases; The Maven and Gradle tree models, run configurations of goals and tasks, typed lines and completion are unit-tested on the functions the tool windows and the Execute popup call. Missing: resolving a pom.xml path to its Maven project, which only the missing Analyze Dependencies menus use.

cases.case: Maven tree › shows profiles, then the aggregator with lifecycle, plugins and its modules
cases.note: Same fixture and labels/icons; `maven_roots`/`maven_children` reached from the window through BuildToolView's rows (view.rs `visible_rows` -> model.rs `roots`/`children`).

cases.case: Maven tree › expands plugins to goals and dependencies to their transitive ones
cases.note: Same assertions; `maven_children` reached from the window through BuildToolView's rows (view.rs `visible_rows` -> model.rs `roots`/`children`).

cases.case: Maven tree › lists the project's maven run configurations
cases.note: Same configs and labels; `maven_run_configs` is called by `maven_children` reached from the window through BuildToolView's rows (view.rs `visible_rows` -> model.rs `roots`/`children`).

cases.case: Maven tree › expand all opens folders but not dependency subtrees
cases.note: Same keys asserted; `expandable_keys` is what view.rs `expand_all` uses (Expand All).

cases.case: Maven runs › keeps explicit Maven profiles %j
cases.note: The four profile spellings in a loop; `maven_goal_config` -> `maven_args`, called by model.rs `node_config` (tree run) and execute.rs `execute_config` (Execute popup).

cases.case: Maven runs › passes goals, offline, skip tests and changed profiles
cases.note: Same expectations (name, command, args, cwd, env, isTest, mvn for a non-wrapper, typed -s kept); reached through `node_config` and `execute_config`.

cases.case: Maven runs › parses typed command lines
cases.note: Same four lines; `parse_goal_line`/`parse_task_line` are called by execute.rs `execute_config`.

cases.case: Maven runs › completes phases and plugin goals for the last word, history for the whole line
cases.note: Same inputs and labels; `goal_completions` is called by execute.rs `ExecuteState::completions`, the popup's rows.

cases.case: Gradle tree and runs › nests subprojects and groups tasks, other last
cases.note: Same fixture and labels; `gradle_roots`/`gradle_children` reached from the window through BuildToolView's rows (view.rs `visible_rows` -> model.rs `roots`/`children`).

cases.case: Gradle tree and runs › runs tasks by path from the build directory
cases.note: Same config fields; `gradle_task_config` is called by `node_config` and `execute_config`.

cases.case: Gradle tree and runs › keeps identical project paths and tasks of independent builds distinct
cases.note: Same two builds, distinct keys and ids, second build's wrapper/cwd/env; keys are made by `gradle_project_key`, used by view.rs and execute.rs `project_choices`.

cases.case: Gradle tree and runs › shows run configurations only under their owning linked build
cases.note: Same configs and ids; `gradle_run_configs` is called by `gradle_children` reached from the window through BuildToolView's rows (view.rs `visible_rows` -> model.rs `roots`/`children`).

cases.case: Gradle tree and runs › places a saved run under its directly linked root instead of a longer sibling composite
cases.note: Same composite/direct builds; `gradle_run_configs` via `gradle_children`.

cases.case: Gradle tree and runs › completes task names and paths
cases.note: Same inputs; `task_completions` is called by execute.rs `ExecuteState::completions`.

cases.case: resolves the Maven model POM %s at %s
cases.note: `maven_pom_at_path` has a matching unit test (`build_tools::model::tests::resolves_the_maven_model_pom_at_its_path`) but nothing in app-gpui calls it: in the webview it serves Analyze Dependencies on a pom.xml (editor, tab and Project view menus), which the native app does not have.

unit:src/features/build-tools/ExecutePop.proof: `build_tools::execute::tests::separates_recent_commands_from_maven_goals_and_accepts_a_recent_command_with_tab`, `build_tools::execute::tests::skips_section_headers_during_keyboard_navigation`, `build_tools::execute::tests::omits_the_empty_recent_section_when_no_commands_have_been_run`, `build_tools::execute::tests::starts_page_up_on_a_completion_rather_than_a_section`, `build_tools::execute::tests::navigates_sections_and_wraps`, `build_tools::execute::tests::clears_selection_when_typing_changes_the_rows_and_ignores_section_clicks`, `build_tools::execute::tests::keeps_an_empty_completion_list_safe_for_all_navigation_and_acceptance_keys`, `build_tools::execute::tests::page_down_selects_a_completion_rather_than_a_section_at_its_landing_position`, `build_tools::execute::tests::resets_selection_when_changing_the_gradle_build_used_for_completion`; 9 of 9 cases; The popup's sections, keyboard navigation with wrapping and paging, Tab and Enter acceptance, typing and section clicks, and the Gradle build change are tested on the popup's state, which its key, click and chooser handlers drive.

cases.case: separates recent commands from Maven goals and accepts a recent command with Tab
cases.note: Same history and sections, Tab fills the recent line; the popup's keys reach it through execute.rs `ExecutePopup::claim_key` (down/up/pagedown/pageup -> `move_selection`, tab -> `tab`, enter -> `enter`). The window shows Recent again after a run in `workbench::build_tools::tests::execute_maven_goal_runs_the_typed_line_and_offers_it_again_as_recent`.

cases.case: skips section headers during keyboard navigation
cases.note: Down, Down, Tab gives `clean `; the popup's keys reach it through execute.rs `ExecutePopup::claim_key` (down/up/pagedown/pageup -> `move_selection`, tab -> `tab`, enter -> `enter`).

cases.case: omits the empty Recent section when no commands have been run
cases.note: First row is the Maven Goals section, no Recent; Tab gives `clean `; the popup draws `ExecuteState::rows`.

cases.case: starts PageUp on a completion rather than a section
cases.note: PageUp then Enter accepts `clean ` instead of running; the popup's keys reach it through execute.rs `ExecutePopup::claim_key` (down/up/pagedown/pageup -> `move_selection`, tab -> `tab`, enter -> `enter`).

cases.case: navigates sections and wraps with %j
cases.note: The five key sequences and expected lines in a loop; the popup's keys reach it through execute.rs `ExecutePopup::claim_key` (down/up/pagedown/pageup -> `move_selection`, tab -> `tab`, enter -> `enter`). Up wrapping to the last row is also driven through the window in `workbench::build_tools::tests::the_execute_list_scrolls_to_the_completion_the_keyboard_selects`.

cases.case: clears selection when typing changes the rows, and ignores section clicks
cases.note: Typing clears the selection (the field's change calls `set_line`), a section click is ignored (`ExecutePopup::click_row` -> `accept`).

cases.case: keeps an empty completion list safe for all navigation and acceptance keys
cases.note: Every key leaves `-Dunknown`, no rows; Enter runs the line itself (the webview's Enter does the same through Run Anything).

cases.case: PageDown selects a completion rather than a section at its landing position
cases.note: Same nine recent lines, Down, PageDown, Enter accepts the first goal; the popup's keys reach it through execute.rs `ExecutePopup::claim_key` (down/up/pagedown/pageup -> `move_selection`, tab -> `tab`, enter -> `enter`).

cases.case: resets selection when changing the Gradle build used for completion
cases.note: Choosing the other build clears the selection and Tab completes its task; an emptied model keeps the line. The native chooser is a row of names (`ExecutePopup::choose_project` -> `set_project`), not the webview's listbox.

unit:src/features/build-tools/actions.te.proof: `build_tools::view::tests::runs_a_lifecycle_phase_through_the_run_feature_with_the_toolbar_options`, `build_tools::view::tests::does_not_mark_gradle_test_tasks_as_skipped_when_maven_skip_tests_is_on`; 2 of 4 cases; A phase run from the Maven tree with Skip Tests striking and applied, and Gradle test tasks left unstruck. Missing: the action list with Add Maven Projects and Analyze Dependencies; the window leaving when the POM goes, with its title, icon and anchor.

cases.case: build tools feature › registers the Maven tool window only while the project has a POM
cases.note: Implemented (workbench/build_tools.rs `sync_build_tool_windows` unregisters it when the model has no Maven project) but no test removes the POM and sees the window and `build.maven` go, nor reads the window's title, icon and right anchor; the tests only show it absent with no model and present with one.

cases.case: build tools feature › offers its actions in Search Everywhere only for Maven projects and toggles run options
cases.note: Add Maven Projects and Analyze Dependencies are not in the native app, so the action list differs; the toggles, Reload's availability and Execute Goal opening are shown by the window tests.

cases.case: build tools feature › runs a lifecycle phase through the run feature with the toolbar options
cases.note: The view shows the stale banner, strikes the test phase while Skip Tests is on and runs `spring-demo [test]` with `/p/mvnw test -DskipTests` (Enter instead of a double click). Flipping Skip Tests from the action and the run through the Run window are in `workbench::build_tools::tests::runs_a_lifecycle_phase_through_the_run_feature_with_the_toolbar_options`.

cases.case: build tools feature › does not mark Gradle test tasks as skipped when Maven Skip Tests is on
cases.note: Gradle view with Skip Tests on: its test task row is not struck.

unit:src/features/build-tools/linkage.te.proof: `workbench::build_tools::tests::links_from_the_toolbar_and_keeps_link_available_after_unlinking_the_final_build`, `build_tools::model::tests::keeps_identical_project_paths_and_tasks_of_independent_builds_distinct`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::does_not_link_or_start_gradle_imports_in_an_untrusted_project`; 4 of 16 cases; Gradle Link and Unlink from the toolbar and the root's menu, a cancelled or module unlink changing nothing, duplicate task paths running with their own build's wrapper and folder, and no link or import in an untrusted project. Missing: a reload on applied script changes; Add and Unlink Maven Projects (seven cases); dropping a late link answer; Reload of one chosen build; Link and Unlink off in a Workspace window.

cases.case: re-reads the build model when an applied Groovy or Kotlin script changes
cases.note: The window reloads its model on build-file changes through platform/project_presentation.rs `changes_build_model`, which only knows pom.xml, build.gradle(.kts) and settings.gradle(.kts); an applied script such as gradle/dependencies.gradle does not reload it (`is_gradle_build_input` knows it but only the libraries refresh uses it).

cases.case: offers unlink on a root's context menu and persists a confirmed project setting
cases.note: Unlink Maven Projects (menu entry, confirmation, unlinkedProjects setting).

cases.case: does not write after cancelled confirmation
cases.note: Unlink Maven Projects.

cases.case: unlinks a module of a linked reactor so only the modules in use are imported
cases.note: Unlink Maven Projects on a module.

cases.case: ignores a POM that is not in the Maven model
cases.note: Unlink Maven Projects.

cases.case: re-adds a picked POM using the plus button and preserves other unlinked roots
cases.note: Add Maven Projects (toolbar button and file picker).

cases.case: ignores cancelled, invalid, outside or already linked picks: %s
cases.note: Add Maven Projects.

cases.case: links picked POMs that no reactor lists as independent top-level projects
cases.note: Add Maven Projects (linkedProjects setting).

cases.case: unlinking a linked independent project removes the link instead of hiding it
cases.note: Unlink Maven Projects of a linked independent project.

cases.case: links from the toolbar and keeps Link available after unlinking the final build
cases.note: Link from the toolbar button with a picked settings.gradle, the root's menu offers Unlink with its buildDir, confirmed unlink removes it, after the last build the tree is empty and Link stays on the toolbar.

cases.case: leaves links unchanged when unlink is cancelled or a module is targeted
cases.note: The same test unlinks `<build>/app` (no dialog) and cancels the dialog with Escape: the build stays listed.

cases.case: runs duplicate task paths with the selected build's wrapper, cwd and offline setting
cases.note: The second of two builds with the same paths runs with its own wrapper, folder and JAVA_HOME and `:app:test --offline`; a tree row's activation reaches `gradle_task_config` with the row's own build through model.rs `node_config`, and a typed line runs in the chosen build's folder through `execute_config` (`build_tools::execute::tests::a_typed_line_runs_in_the_chosen_project_and_is_kept_without_its_launcher`). No window test has two builds.

cases.case: drops a late link result after the user changes projects
cases.note: Implemented (workbench/build_tools.rs `gradle_linked` drops an answer from an older `epoch`) but no test changes the project while a link is pending.

cases.case: routes Reload to the chosen independent build
cases.note: Implemented (`gradle.reload` passes its `buildDir` to `request_build_sync`) but no test reloads one build of several.

cases.case: does not offer Link or Unlink for a native Workspace window
cases.note: Link and Unlink are not disabled in a workspace window: their handlers check only the project root and trust.

cases.case: does not link or start Gradle imports in an untrusted project
cases.note: In Restricted Mode Link asks for no build file, Reload is unavailable and the backend refuses a sync; nothing runs.

feature:build-tools.proof: `workbench::build_tools::tests::runs_a_lifecycle_phase_through_the_run_feature_with_the_toolbar_options`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::reload_reads_the_dependency_trees_with_maven_and_refreshes_the_tree`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::stop_cancels_a_running_sync_without_an_error`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::gradle_reload_lists_the_reported_tasks_and_a_failed_sync_is_told`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::a_task_runs_by_its_path_with_the_builds_wrapper_and_offline`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::execute_maven_goal_runs_the_typed_line_and_offers_it_again_as_recent`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::the_execute_list_scrolls_to_the_completion_the_keyboard_selects`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::links_from_the_toolbar_and_keeps_link_available_after_unlinking_the_final_build`, `workbench::build_tools::tests::does_not_link_or_start_gradle_imports_in_an_untrusted_project`; the Maven and Gradle tool windows with their trees, toolbars and options, Reload with progress, Stop and its errors, phase, goal and task runs through the Run window, the Execute popup with completion and recent lines, Gradle Link and Unlink, and nothing linked or synced in Restricted Mode.
